description: Carry an arcane gold ingot into a meadow and complete a Light Communion beneath an open sky.

ai_assignment_context.assignment_prompt: Go where the sky is open and the light is unbroken. Let the meadow witness your communion and return with your purpose clear.
completion_phrases: You have learned to carry light into places that have forgotten it.
The radiance answers more freely now that you have shown it where you stand.
